decisions.reason: Identifies the colliding workspace-files insert rows from both patch excerpts, locates the rejection at EntryGroup.update during the cordis:include apply from boot-crash-log.txt, explains the id-uniqueness fail-fast over last-write-wins, and rejects the profile comment claiming the duplicate is harmless redundancy.

Distinguishes all three operations: config override by existing id is safe, inserting a genuinely new unprovided id is safe, inserting a bundle-provided id is fatal; classifies the maintainer row as the third case, grounded in the identical id/name rows of both excerpts.

Removes only the manually added workspace-files insert block from the profile cordis.patch.yml, preserves the bundle-provided service and unrelated external plugin rows, and states config changes should use override rather than a second insert; no renaming, bundle deletion, or additional insert.

Explains the crash is a profile composition error caught in the loader before any plugin code runs, so no plugin-side change can fix the duplicate id, and keeps the earlier resource-metadata read failure as a separate unresolved problem requiring verification against upgrade/migration guidance.

Advises grepping the installed web-app bundle cordis.patch.yml (Select-String on the id) before any insert and only inserting ids no bundle ships; proposes a host diagnostic that names workspace-files and both declaration origins (bundle L110 vs profile L18) and points to deleting the redundant profile block, plus a pre-boot conflict precheck.

caps.reason: The final advice removes the duplicate and explicitly denies both silent-merge and plugin-edit cures; the profile comment endorsing redundancy is quoted only to reject it.
